summary: Recent updates to the camera and audio capture functionality in Firefox aim to improve the performance and reliability of media recording. One key change is the introduction of **fractional framerate decimation**, which allows the browser to adjust camera framerates more effectively to meet user requests, enhancing the quality of video calls and recordings. Additionally, when users record a browser window in a privileged context, Firefox will now invalidate the device cache to ensure that the captured content is fresh and accurate, preventing outdated information from being used. _These upgrades help provide a smoother and more seamless media experience for users._
